description: Evaluates a business idea in Brazil by how many companies are registered for it: the idea is mapped to a CNAE activity code and a place, and the answer counts the active, opened and closed companies there, shows how they are set up and gives a plain reading of the numbers. It does not estimate search volume and does not promise demand: `ficha.limites` says what the numbers do not show. Up to 30 AI analyses a day per network, shared with ia_filters; after that, the tool answers `limite_diario` with `renova_em`.

municipio.description: Municipality hint: the Federal Revenue municipality code.

texto.description: The idea in Portuguese, 3 to 400 characters, such as "padaria em Campinas".

uf.description: State hint (two-letter code) when the text names no city.

name: avaliar
title: Evaluate a business idea
